name: Barbadillo del Mercado (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided red over white with a light blue triangle at the hoist bearing the crowned municipal arms of Barbadillo del Mercado (a castle and a lion).
history: Municipal flag of Barbadillo del Mercado; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: triangle with its base along the hoist
